purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Mimika Regency evidence establishes Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Mimika as the local registry custodian for Timika/Mimika. BHUMI is the national ATR/BPN public map viewer. No anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local registry custody is supported by official Mimika Regency reporting and an official court document identifying the Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Mimika office in Timika. This is distinct from national ATR/BPN documentation and does not prove citywide open geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Mimika Regency page reports a meeting at Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Mimika and names its ATR/BPN leadership.
Official Mimika legal-document host contains a court record identifying the Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Mimika address as Jl. Cenderawasih SP 2, Timika.
Official BHUMI documentation describes the ATR/BPN interactive spatial map and its ATLAS integration.
